name: DaVinci Resolve
summary: A desktop video editor with a free edition that also covers colour, effects and audio.
description: DaVinci Resolve is a desktop application for editing video. Beyond cutting clips together, the same program handles colour correction, visual effects, motion graphics and audio post-production, so you can take a project from raw footage to a finished export without switching tools. A free edition is offered alongside a paid edition called DaVinci Resolve Studio. It is a large, professional-grade tool, so beginners should expect to spend time learning it.

pricing.free_tier_details: A free edition ('DaVinci Resolve') is offered as a free download on the official site.
pricing.paid_plan_summary: A paid edition, DaVinci Resolve Studio, is sold through the official site. On 2026-10-21 the page showed US$236 (reduced from US$295); prices vary and this may be promotional. The page did not state whether the licence is a one-time purchase.

key_capabilities.text: Combines editing, colour correction, visual effects, motion graphics and audio post-production in one application.
Includes AI-assisted features powered by the 'DaVinci AI Neural Engine', such as facial recognition, smart reframing and voice isolation.

limitations.text: Some capabilities are reserved for the paid Studio edition; check the official comparison before relying on a specific feature.
A large professional application: expect a steep learning curve and check the official system requirements before downloading on an older computer.

best_for: People who want a free editor that can grow with them into colour grading and audio work
Creators producing longer or more polished videos
not_ideal_for: Older or low-powered computers (check system requirements first)
getting_started: Download the free edition from the official DaVinci Resolve page.
Work through Blackmagic Design's official training material before your first real project.
Start a short practice project: import clips, trim them on the timeline and export.
